summary: Danish political scientist Bjorn Lomborg's 2001 book The Skeptical Environmentalist misused data to downplay climate change and extinction, making him a media darling and a think-tank figure whose talking points stalled climate action.

credulous press coverage, 2001 New York Times profile
E. O. Wilson rebuts his species extinction figures

media ubiquity on TV networks after the English edition
Danish ministry finds the work dishonest but cannot sanction him
Copenhagen Consensus Center founded, 2008 priority ranking
2016 Australian education department paid his center for a report
funding of his center by right-wing donors and his salary
recent PragerU and Fox Business appearances up to 2019
